name: Being With Jesus
overview: Scripture reveals that being with Jesus is central to the believer's hope and salvation, as He is the only way to the Father and eternal life. God’s nearness is assured to all who call upon Him in truth, emphasizing a personal and intimate relationship with Christ. Jesus promises to prepare a place for His followers and to return to bring them to Himself, underscoring the eternal fellowship believers will share with Him. This relationship is grounded in God’s love, demonstrated by the gift of His beloved Son, whom we are called to hear and trust.
